overall.verdict: A disciplined, premium-feeling dark wallet whose absolute-scale bar idea and bilateral-account transparency are genuinely differentiated; power users get real evidence (frames, proofs, evidence bundles). It is held back by unexplained protocol jargon (entity id, frames, lanes, collateral slider), duplicated information surfaces, and several clipped/dense layouts that would stall a first-timer at the exact moments money moves.
priority_fixes: Plain-language layer for the money-moment jargon: entity id, frames/proof, collateral-vs-credit, lanes — one-line glosses or popovers on Pay, Receive, Swap and Sovereignty (Maya, Sofia, Dmitri).
Unify the two green swatches (on-chain vs secured) into one 'yours whatever happens' bucket with subtext, on Home and Sovereignty (Maya, Ravi).
Fix clipped/broken elements: Pay CTA at screen edge, Move-into-reserve button overflow, settings chips and filter chips overflowing (Lena, everyone).
Make evidence actionable: tap proof hashes, pin 'Save evidence bundle' near the Sovereignty headline, link '2 committed entries' to frames (Kenji, Ravi).
Simplify Move and the Swap 'Prepare to receive' panel: compact FROM/TO pickers, split the collateral slider into advanced, generate WHAT HAPPENS from the actual selection (Anya, Fatima, Tomasz).
